recap: Day 1 (June 25, 2026) introduced Safeeely - an AI-escrow bot for DM deals (social media sales, freelance gigs, crypto) used via Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp/Instagram/Apple bots under a 'safetag' handle. Days 1-18 covered early money bugs, a WhatsApp notification chase, a huge solo admin-dashboard build, a 44-field settings rebuild, badge cards across all six bots, a five-leak memory hunt, free in-house support ticketing built by reusing the dispute system's pipes, an AI feedback-digest tool, a raw STEP_UP_REQUIRED error code shown to users, and a third instance of the same missing-await bug spiking server memory during dispute auto-enforcement. Day 19 (July 6, 2026) fixed the STEP_UP_REQUIRED saga for real with an emailed OTP that self-elevates the session. Day 20 (also July 6, later that morning) rebuilt the public guides/delivery page and fixed a dead-end 'Dashboard' CTA on it. Day 21 (July 6, same evening) closed out two more bugs found while re-walking the just-shipped withdrawal flow: saving a payout method and confirming a withdrawal required two separate identity verifications for what felt like one action, so they were merged into a single step-up; and a withdrawal that failed at the payment provider (money never left the user) was vanishing from the visible balance same as a successful payout. This was the last real commit before the story caught up to live history - the backfill is fully closed out, and future days cover new product commits as they land (the story system's own commits are not narrated).
